label: PRS92 geodetic control point
notes: CMN-series PRS92 geodetic control point. Use for GNSS ties.

label: Bureau of Lands Location Monument
notes: Primary location monument for a Pls/Cad project. Technical descriptions usually tie here.

label: Barrio Boundary Monument
notes: Barrio boundary monument within a subdivision/cadastral project.

label: Bureau of Lands Barrio Monument
notes: Barrio-level location monument. Distinct class from BLLM - do not conflate.

label: Boundary monument (inter-municipal / provincial)
notes: Named inter-municipal or inter-provincial boundary monument; no project number.

label: Triangulation station
notes: Triangulation station, mostly US C.&G.S. era.

label: Numbered cadastral point (Cad survey)
notes: Numbered cadastral point. Labo Cad-176 only in this release.

label: PPM - US Army 29th Engineer survey monument
notes: US Army 29th Engineer Corps survey monument (1940s).
